tools.description: Register an agent in the Persephone registry: its name, its platform, its mailbox address, and the capabilities it can actually perform. Registration is how other agents learn the agent exists and what trust level the owner assigned it.
tools.name: register_agent

tools.description: Create a task on the board. A task has a title, instructions, an optional assignee, an optional parent workflow, and hard limits (max_iterations, deadline) that travel with it.
tools.name: create_task

tools.description: List tasks on the board, optionally filtered by status or assignee. This is the queue a reader task checks each cycle.
tools.name: list_tasks

tools.description: Claim a queued task for one agent. The first claim wins; a task that is already claimed cannot be claimed again.
tools.name: claim_task

tools.description: Update a task's status or append a progress note to its log. Use blocked with a reason when a host platform gate stops the work; blocked is a correct outcome, not a failure.
tools.name: update_task

tools.description: Hand the next step of a task to another agent: creates a follow-on task linked to this one and records the handoff in both logs. A handoff never grants the receiving agent new permissions; cross-agent transfers follow the owner's data-sharing policy.
tools.name: handoff_task

tools.description: Complete a task with its artifact or evidence. A completion without an artifact is recorded as a claim, not a completion.
tools.name: complete_task

tools.description: Cancel a task. Cancellation stops future execution of that task immediately and is recorded in the audit log.
tools.name: cancel_task

tools.description: Read the completion report and audit log for a task or a whole workflow: what happened, why, who initiated it, what was shared, and how it ended.
tools.name: get_report
